Reference image is mood/pixel-style only; the visible water is specifically REJECTED and MUST be completely removed. The camera is IN a dense ancient forest hollow at walking height, not looking at a landscape from outside. Wide2.6:1 pixel-art environment. Cropped close enormous ridged trunk at left, thick interlaced above-ground roots under our feet, soft leaf litter, dry moss, scattered acorns and mushrooms, recognizable fern and broadleaf layers near camera. Midground a shaded small DRY clearing and a diagonally fallen moss-covered log on the right; behind it many upright close trunks sink into deep indigo shadow. The ground remains visibly solid dry earth all the way back. Sparse warm fireflies hover close to roots and fungi, a few silver moonbeams filter from overhead canopy, moon disk is hidden. No distant panoramic horizon, no symmetrical gateway, no straight central path to a vista. Asymmetric detailed composition, distinct near/middle/deep forest layers. Palette midnight plum, indigo, muted moss-green and amber pinlights, preserve approved cozy deep pixel art texture.
ABSOLUTE EXCLUSIONS: NO water of any kind, NO lake, NO pond, NO river, NO stream, NO blue reflective ground, NO liquid reflections or rippling highlights. Also no lava, no snow, no ruins, no mountain vista, no coastline, no ocean. This picture must be instantly identified as being inside a forest, never a lake shore. No Pokemon, no people, no UI, no lettering, no botanical border. Natural forest ground for future sprites near lower middle. Painterly depth via crisp authored pixel clusters, not photorealistic or smooth3D. High-quality unique welcoming place.

This is a detail specification, not full windows. Generous dark gutters, readable large Russian, no landscape or decoration, no botanical elements. Show precisely these six state variants with numbered external headings.
01 'Прерывание похода': two clearly separated labeled action-row variants. 'Сохранение': disabled danger button with spinner 'Прерываем…', disabled neutral 'Оставить в пути'. Below 'Ошибка': inline coral message 'Не удалось прервать поход. Повторите попытку.' then enabled neutral 'Оставить в пути' and enabled muted red 'Повторить'. No reward claim or success label.

03 'Результат со встречей': heading 'Находки уже в запасах', compact real reward row 'Равст ×3' '12 монет' '150 XP каждому'. A separate encounter block normal pixel Bulbasaur sprite, name 'Bulbasaur', small 'Встреча в роще', outlined secondary 'Открыть встречу'. Bottom apricot 'Продолжить'. Known revealed encounter example, do not show silhouette.
04 'Результат без встречи': heading 'Находки уже в запасах', SAME compact reward row 'Равст ×3' '12 монет' '150 XP каждому', no encounter panel, no empty placeholder and no sad no-luck message. Bottom apricot 'Продолжить'.
